description: Labeled regression set for the GRM weekly detection. Seeded from the 2026-09-26 and 2026-10-03 audits. After any config change, run the current search + classification rules against every case; a change ships only when all complaint cases are still detected with the right agency and category, and every drill reproduces the documented miss or exclusion.
